ValidationRule.description: Age at hire (ADDMONTHS), leap-day birthdays, termination ordering, grade-based salary bands (CASE) scaled for part-timers, and a log-scaled bonus ceiling.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Hire_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Birthdate__c)), OR( ADDMONTHS(Birthdate__c, 192) > Hire_Date__c, Hire_Date__c > TODAY() + 90, AND(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Intern'), ADDMONTHS(Birthdate__c, 312) < Hire_Date__c), AND(MONTH(Birthdate__c) = 2, DAY(Birthdate__c) = 29, MOD(YEAR(Birthdate__c), 4) <> 0), YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Birthdate__c) > 75 ) ), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Termination_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Hire_Date__c)), Termination_Date__c < Hire_Date__c), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Salary__c)), Salary__c > 0, OR( Salary__c < CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Junior', 40000, 'Mid', 65000, 'Senior', 90000, 'Staff', 120000, 'Principal', 150000, 'Director', 180000, 0) * IF(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Part Time'), MIN(1, NULLVALUE(Weekly_Hours__c, 40) / 40), 1), Salary__c > CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Junior', 90000, 'Mid', 130000, 'Senior', 190000, 'Staff', 260000, 'Principal', 350000, 'Director', 600000, 10000000), NULLVALUE(Bonus__c, 0) > Salary__c * ROUND(LN(Salary__c) / 40, 2), FLOOR(LOG(Salary__c)) < 4 ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Hire/birth/termination dates or salary/bonus are outside the allowed bands.
